The '''Maryx Minor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sujimis sector/Legends|Sujimis sector]]. It contained a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the same name, [[Maryx Minor/Legends|Maryx Minor]].
